title: The museum and its props
summary: Not everything in R.E.P.O. is a weapon or a valuable: the game defines props of its own, including a museum piece, and gives cosmetic objects a condition of their own.
body: The game defines props as objects in the world rather than as scenery, which is why something like a museum piece is its own thing.
Cosmetic objects carry a condition of their own, so decoration is not purely visual in the data even if it looks that way in play.
Inside the between-run shop there is a machine for cosmetics, which is where these objects come from rather than from the level.
What this entry does not tell you: prices, what any prop is worth or whether a prop can be damaged. We have not verified those numbers, so we do not print them.

facts.claim: The game defines its own museum props rather than only scenery.
facts.evidence: identifier: MuseumPropMoneyHead

facts.claim: Cosmetic objects have a condition tracked in the game.
facts.evidence: identifier: CosmeticWorldObjectHealth

facts.claim: Cosmetics come from a machine in the between-run shop.
facts.evidence: identifier: CosmeticShopMachine

facts.claim: The build names the museum's own floors in wood and in concrete, including a floor piece made for hiding.
facts.evidence: asset names: Floor Museum Wood, Floor Museum Concrete Bright NEW, Floor_1x0.5 museum hidey

facts.claim: A broken statue and a broken artwork are named among the museum's props.
facts.evidence: asset names: Broken statue, Broken Artwork Broken Statue

facts.claim: The museum has ambience of its own, kept as separate loops including one for its elevator shaft.
facts.evidence: asset names: Ambience Loop Museum Elevator Shaft, Ambience Loop Museum Maint, Ambience Loop Museum Hell

facts.claim: Its artwork is hung rather than built in: the museum ships painting stands and dirty paintings of its own.
facts.evidence: asset names: Museum Painting Stand, DirtyPainting

facts.claim: The painting stands come in more than one build.
facts.evidence: asset names: Museum Painting Stand H, Museum Painting Stand sss

facts.claim: The paintings have a back of their own, with a colour sheet kept for it.
facts.evidence: asset names: Museum Painting Back, Museum Painting_Back_Albedo

facts.claim: The paintings have a back, a vertical frame and stands with their own sheets.
facts.evidence: asset names: Museum Painting_Back_Albedo, Painting Frame Vertical_Normal, Painting stands_DefaultMaterial_Normal

facts.claim: The museum also ships shadow decals of its own, a round one and a square one.
facts.evidence: asset names: Museum Decal Shadow Round, Museum Decal Shadow Square

facts.claim: The museum ships decals of its own: paper, dirt and hanging dust.
facts.evidence: asset names: Museum Decal Paper01, Museum Decal Dirt01, Museum Decal Hanging Dust Alpha01

facts.claim: The decals are numbered in sets, with dirt two and three and paper two among them.
facts.evidence: asset names: Museum Decal Dirt02, Museum Decal Dirt03, Museum Decal Paper02

facts.claim: The paper and dirt decals run to at least five each.
facts.evidence: asset names: Museum Decal Paper05, Museum Decal Dirt05

facts.claim: The paintings are a set of their own, with a wide landscape, a portrait and a surrealist canvas among them.
facts.evidence: asset names: Painting_H_Landscape, Painting_V_Furman, Painting_V_surrealistic, Painting_S_Tree

facts.claim: The set runs to a signed portrait and a grinning canvas as well.
facts.evidence: asset names: Painting_V_jannk, Painting_S_Creep

facts.claim: The decals are numbered further than five: the dirt set reaches seven and the paper set six.
facts.evidence: asset names: Museum Decal Dirt06, Museum Decal Dirt07, Museum Decal Paper06

facts.claim: The statuary is a set of its own: a golden statue and a marble one, a bust with its own sheets, and broken sculptures with a colour sheet and a normal map, beside a cubic sculpture material.
facts.evidence: asset names: Golden Statue, Marble Statue, Axel Bust_DefaultMaterial_BaseColor, Broken Artwork Broken Sculptures, Broken Sculptures_DefaultMaterial_BaseColor, Broken Sculptures_DefaultMaterial_Normal, Cubic sculpture material

facts.claim: The museum keeps a cafe bar of its own: a desk with pumps, a menu, a keg, a fridge and the hinge named for that fridge's door.
facts.evidence: asset names: Museum Cafe Bar Desk, Museum Cafe Bar Pumps, Museum Cafe Bar Menu, Museum  Cafe Bar Keg, Museum Cafe Bar Fridge, Hinge Template - Cafe Bar Fridge Door

facts.claim: A coffee maker is named with a glass sheet and an emission sheet beside it.
facts.evidence: asset names: Coffee Maker, Coffee Maker Glass, Coffee Maker Emission

facts.claim: The museum's cafe carries boxes of its own, and the desk has pumps named for it.
facts.evidence: asset names: Cafe box1, Cafe box2, Cafe box3, Cafe desk pumps

facts.claim: The museum's small props have an emission switch named for them.
facts.evidence: asset name: Museum Small Props Emission OFF

facts.claim: The museum carries signs of its own: a museum sign, a no-smoking sign and artist signs numbered from the first.
facts.evidence: asset names: Museum Sign, Museum Sign No Smoking, Museum Artistsign01, Artistsign01

alt.en: One of the paintings the game itself places in the museum level.
alt.zh: 游戏本身放在博物馆关卡中的画作之一。

alt.en: A second painting the game itself hangs in the museum: a crow's head in purple and black on a warm red ground.
alt.zh: 游戏自己挂在博物馆里的第二幅画：暖红底上的紫黑色乌鸦头部。

alt.en: One of the game's own paintings: a wide landscape with a river, wooded hills and a small barn on a green field.
alt.zh: 游戏自带的画作之一：一幅横幅风景画，河湾、林坡与绿地上的小谷仓。

alt.en: One of the game's own paintings: a dark portrait of a man in glasses with a hand raised to his chin.
alt.zh: 游戏自带的画作之一：深色肖像画，戴眼镜的男子一手托着下巴。

alt.en: One of the game's own paintings: a surreal canvas of a red apple with an eye in it, floating over dark hills.
alt.zh: 游戏自带的画作之一：超现实画作，一只嵌着眼睛的红苹果悬在暗色山丘之上。

alt.en: One of the game's own paintings: a lone tree bending over a flat field under a dark sky.
alt.zh: 游戏自带的画作之一：暗色天空下，旷野上一棵倾斜的孤树。

alt.en: One of the game's own paintings: a portrait of a bearded man in glasses, a shirt and a tie.
alt.zh: 游戏自带的画作之一：留胡子的男子肖像，戴眼镜、穿着衬衫与领带。

alt.en: One of the game's own paintings: a dark canvas with a pale grinning face in it.
alt.zh: 游戏自带的画作之一：暗色画布上浮现一张苍白的咧嘴笑脸。

alt.en: A banner the museum hangs: a tall poster for a Moose Fighting exhibition, with a moose head and the line Witness the Carnage.
alt.zh: 博物馆挂出的横幅：一张瘦长的「Moose Fighting」展览海报，画着驼鹿头，写着 Witness the Carnage。

alt.en: A second exhibition banner the museum hangs: a tall poster headed Ancient Magic Artifacts, with a bandaged hand holding a glowing eye over candle flames.
alt.zh: 博物馆挂出的第二张展览横幅：瘦长海报，标题 Ancient Magic Artifacts，绷带手托着一只发光眼睛，下面是烛火。

alt.en: A third exhibition banner the museum hangs: a tall poster headed The Creatures of Folklore, with a grinning skull above a red tentacle and a many-eyed mass.
alt.zh: 博物馆挂出的第三张展览横幅：瘦长海报，标题 The Creatures of Folklore，咧嘴骷髅下方是红色触手与满布眼睛的一团。

alt.en: A fourth exhibition banner the museum hangs: a tall poster headed Mildly Disturbing Furniture, with a red chair and a pale arm reaching over it.
alt.zh: 博物馆挂出的第四张展览横幅：瘦长海报，标题 Mildly Disturbing Furniture，红椅子上一只苍白手臂探出。

alt.en: Diagram: you return to the shop, buy a cosmetic from the machine, place a prop, and its condition is tracked.
alt.zh: 博物馆与道具示意图：回到商店、从机器购买外观、摆放道具、其状态被记录。

images.disclaimer: Original diagram drawn for this site. It is not a screenshot of the game.

alt.en: A further exhibition banner the museum hangs: a figure in a sheet skirt under the repeated word Bravery, headed Gregory Mittens.
alt.zh: 博物馆挂出的又一张展览横幅：身裹床单的人物，背景反复写着 Bravery，标题 Gregory Mittens。

alt.en: A further exhibition banner: a dog taped to a wall, headed Good Dogs Taped on Bad Walls and presented by a museum of human art.
alt.zh: 又一张展览横幅：被胶带粘在墙上的狗，标题 Good Dogs Taped on Bad Walls，署名 human art 博物馆。

alt.en: A further exhibition banner: a face behind pink type reading Silverdance, a collection of wax dolls portraying the richest man alive.
alt.zh: 又一张展览横幅：粉色字体 Silverdance 之后的特写面孔，副题是「以蜡像演绎世上最富有的人」。

sources: A local copy of the game, read only. The grounding for each fact is listed on the technical reference pages; nothing here is estimated.
